claims.statement: The model is pretrained on ImageNet-1k natural images, not fluorescence microscopy.
It expects 224x224 RGB input with ImageNet normalization; 512x512 inputs must be resized or tiled.
The 1000-class head must be replaced with a 6-class head; head-first fine-tuning is the documented approach.

open_questions: Is 512px input required or can images be downsampled?
subject: microsoft/resnet-18 for 6-class fluorescence microscopy
hardware_requirements: 11.7M parameters; CPU inference plausible within 50 ms at 224 px (unmeasured here)
